title: Daily Market Briefing — 26 November 2026
summary: US inflation and GDP data strengthened higher-for-longer concerns, while technology shares sold off and Indian equities rallied on FPI/DII buying and rupee appreciation. Brent's geopolitical risk premium rose; Thanksgiving closes US markets. India's October CPI remains elevated and Q2 GDP is due 30 November.

title: Daily Market Briefing — 25 November 2026
summary: US technology weakness and fresh tariff threats drove a sharp Asian selloff, while the Dow and defensive US sectors held up. India reopened with the Nifty up 1.63% by 09:30 on foreign inflows and lower oil, but October CPI at 6.09% and WPI at 12.29% keep inflation risks elevated. Investors await US Q3 GDP, October PCE and USTR tariff findings.

title: Daily Market Briefing — 24 November 2026
summary: Wall Street staged an AI-led rebound as Nvidia shares surged, while December Fed hike pricing approached 95%. Indian equities fell on 23 November and domestic markets are closed for Guru Nanak Jayanti; inflation, crude supply, foreign flows and the upcoming US PCE release remain key.

title: Daily Market Briefing — 23 November 2026
summary: Global technology shares remained under pressure after Friday's AI-led sell-off, while Indian equities opened higher on continued foreign buying. Oil eased but Gulf shipping risks remain; the briefing tracks market breadth, inflation, rates and the upcoming US PCE release.

title: Daily Market Briefing — 22 November 2026
summary: US technology shares led a sharp global sell-off, while Indian benchmarks rose on bank leadership despite higher India VIX and weaker breadth. Treasury yields fell; Brent closed at $92.59. The briefing flags AI valuation risk, bank breadth and stale weekend GIFT Nifty data.
